capabilities: look up word definitions in a sidebar view
show synonyms for selected words in a popover
create dictionary notes from a customizable template
download offline dictionaries for English and Chinese
set the lookup language per note via frontmatter
extras: Lookups rely on third-party APIs chosen by the user; only allowed APIs are queried. Offline support (about 35 MB download, first look-up needs internet) is experimental for English and Chinese. Advanced Synonym Search makes an extra API call to analyze the sentence context. Plugin is open source and extensible with new APIs.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to look up word definitions or synonyms while reading or writing notes.
summary: Multilingual dictionary that looks up word definitions in a sidebar view and shows synonyms in a popover.
